subject: Marketplace sandbox provisioning and SKU throttling for trial onboarding
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam@cloudpartner.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: CloudPartner Trials <trials@cloudpartner.io>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace sandbox provisioning and SKU throttling for trial onboarding

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the call this morning. We want to move the CloudPartner trial program into the marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure) and need help aligning sandbox provisioning, trial SKUs, and throttling so we don't blow quota during demos. Specific asks: 

- A short-lived sandbox provisioning flow (1-2 hour sandboxes) for partner demo sessions.
- A trial SKU mapping that ties usage to a throttled quota (e.g., 1k tokens/day) and clear metering semantics so our billing and your metering align.
- Any marketplace listing constraints (especially Azure private offers / GCP trials) that would affect entitlements.

Can you share a recommended technical flow, and any docs or matrices we should include in the marketplace submission? We aim to start a pilot week of Nov 16.

Cheers,
Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Partnerships, CloudPartner
liam@cloudpartner.io
[Attachment: partner-trial-outline.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam@cloudpartner.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace sandbox provisioning and SKU throttling for trial onboarding

Hi Liam —

Appreciate the clear asks. We can support the pilot week timeline — below is a proposed plan and immediate next steps. I attached the SKU matrix stub for your team to review.

High-level plan:
1) Sandbox provisioning
   - Short-lived sandboxes: we'll stand up ephemeral demo tenants via our partner sandbox API. Default TTL 2 hours; token refresh allowed once per session.
   - Access: sandbox accounts will be created under a partner alias so we can track tool-usage per partner.

2) Trial SKU & throttling
   - We propose a trial SKU that maps to a throttled token budget (example: TRIAL_BASIC = 1,000 tokens/day, burst 200 tokens/min).
   - Metering: Redwood will emit usage events with SKU and partner_id; CloudPartner will consume and reconcile.

3) Marketplace constraints & entitlements
   - Azure private offers: we need the private offer SKU id to map entitlements; enable the same SKU in private offer metadata.
   - GCP trials: GCP requires explicit trial duration and a billing mapping. We'll share a short checklist.

Immediate asks for you:
- Confirm pilot date (you mentioned Nov 16) — we can open the first batch of sandboxes the morning of Nov 16.
- Review the attached trial-sku-matrix.xlsx and mark any different token budgets or burst patterns.
- Share the marketplace listing contact for your AWS/GCP/Azure publisher accounts so we can coordinate the SKU ids.

I'll loop Ben for the technical implementation and Olga for entitlement/legal constraints.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.inference
[Attachment: trial-sku-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference>, Liam O'Neill <liam@cloudpartner.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace sandbox provisioning and SKU throttling for trial onboarding

Hey all —

Quick technical notes / implementation constraints from the runtime side:

- Sandbox provisioning: We'll provide an API endpoint (/partners/:partner_id/sandboxes) that returns ephemeral API keys scoped to the trial SKU. TTL enforcement happens at the gateway; keys are revoked at TTL expiry.

- Throttling model options (recommendation in bold):
  * Token-budget per SKU per partner (1k tokens/day) — simple and predictable.
  * Token-budget + burst window (1k/day with 200/min burst) — protects demos from spikes. RECOMMENDED.
  * Continuous-leaky-bucket with dynamic scaling — more complex, higher infra cost.

- Metering events: We emit line-level metering in near-real-time to the partner webhook (signed). If CloudPartner wants a batched CSV export we can provide that too.

- Edge cases to consider:
  * Concurrent demo sessions from the same partner alias — we need a shared deduction policy (first-allocate).
  * Marketplace refunds / private-offer adjustments — metering must be tied to a transaction id from the marketplace when available.

Action items for engineering pilot:
- We can enable sandbox API for CloudPartner on Nov 12 for an internal dry run; public pilot Nov 16 as discussed.
- Need CloudPartner to provide publisher account IDs and an endpoint for metering events (HMAC key).

I'll draft an implementation checklist after the dry run.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Developer Relations, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.inference>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Liam O'Neill <liam@cloudpartner.io>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace sandbox provisioning and SKU throttling for trial onboarding

Hi team —

A few legal/entitlement notes to avoid later listing friction: 

- SKU naming in marketplace artifacts must match the SKU we push in metering events; mismatches cause automatic rejection in some publishers. Use a single canonical SKU id per marketplace.

- For Azure private offers, ensure the private offer agreement explicitly references the trial SKU and the duration of the trial. We'll need a signed private offer addendum if you want partner-branded sandboxes with extended TTLs.

- Data residency / telemetry: if CloudPartner requests telemetry forwarding to an EU endpoint we need that flagged now (affects which GCP/Azure region we provision sandboxes in).

- Attachments for review: sandbox-infra-diagram.png illustrates our recommended tenant separation (ephemeral tenants under partner alias). Please validate.

I'll prepare a short contract addendum template for the private-offer scenario and circulate a redline request if you want extended trial terms.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Neill <liam@cloudpartner.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace sandbox provisioning and SKU throttling for trial onboarding

Tessa / team —

Thanks, all — this is exactly what we needed. Confirming next steps from CloudPartner: 

1) We'll provide publisher account IDs and the metering webhook (HMAC key) by end of day Nov 10 (we slipped a day on the internal ops one).
2) Pilot dry run: Nov 12 internal run — please enable sandbox API for our test org on Nov 11 so we can smoke test.
3) Review the attached matrix and propose small changes (if any) by Nov 13.

Olga: we do not require EU telemetry for the pilot — we'll flag that if the pilot scales.

Ben: we accept the recommended token-budget + burst approach.

I'll upload the publisher ids to the Drive link you shared and confirm the webhook URL. Looking forward to the dry run.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Partnerships, CloudPartner
liam@cloudpartner.io
